tools.name: geoa_verify_claim
tools.description: Verify a numeric claim against its cited source (geoa's Gate). Fetches the source page and checks mechanically whether the number appears there and whether the source is circular; with a geoa account it also checks SEMANTICALLY whether the source actually supports the claim. Returns a verdict: suppo

tools.name: geoa_geo_score
tools.description: GEO score for a domain: how ready the site is to be read, understood and cited by AI search engines, measured across 15 technical dimensions. Returns the total score, a grade, and the 3 weakest dimensions (full 15-dimension report requires a geoa account). Results are cached for 6 hours per domain.

tools.name: geoa_ai_visibility
tools.description: Your brand's AI visibility from geoa's stored scans: is your company mentioned when people ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity? Returns mention rate per engine, the top visibility gaps, and which competitors are cited instead. Reads stored scan results only (no live engine calls). Requires sig

tools.name: geoa_draft_from_gap
tools.description: Create a source-verified article draft from an AI-visibility gap (e.g. a question from geoa_ai_visibility). The draft is generated with the customer's Brand Brain, source-verified by the Gate and scored by the Coach — and lands as a DRAFT in Content Studio; nothing is published automatically. Requir

tools.name: geoa_fix_backlog
tools.description: Your current geoa fix queue: the 5 highest-priority GEO fixes served right now (title, effort, impact, delivery channel) plus how many wait in the backlog and how many are verified done. Every fix is closed by MEASUREMENT, never by claim. Read-only — act on fixes in the geoa dashboard. Requires sign

tools.name: geoa_account_status
tools.description: Your geoa plan and usage (articles used/remaining this month). Requires sign-in to a geoa account.

tools.name: geoa_pending_fixes
tools.description: The approved geoa fixes that are NOT yet written into this site's code, for sites built or updated with Claude Code. Each item carries the path (url_pattern), the new value to write, and what geoa measured there before, so you can find the right spot in the repo. A human already approved every item

tools.name: geoa_report_fixes_live
tools.description: Report that you have written the given approved fixes into the site and DEPLOYED them. geoa then fetches the public page as an ordinary visitor and confirms the change is really there — a fix is closed by measurement, never by claim, so a report made before the change is live stays unconfirmed. tools.name: geoa_ready_articles
tools.description: Content Studio articles that are approved and ready to go into the site: title, body (markdown and HTML), meta description, FAQ, JSON-LD and the EU AI Act disclosure, for sites built or updated with Claude Code. Read-only. Requires sign-in to a geoa account.

tools.name: geoa_report_article_published
tools.description: Report that a ready article is now published at a live URL. geoa starts measuring the article's effect on that URL and cross-links the other articles in its cluster to it. Without this, the article stays unpublished in geoa and keeps coming back as ready. Writes to the customer's geoa account. Requi

tools.name: geoa_radar_find_prospects
tools.description: Find B2B prospect companies for a workspace via geoa Radar: discovery by industry+city (or your own seed domains), registry-qualified with Nordic Data (official business registries). Returns a ranked candidate list and a search_id for scoring. Counts against the plan's monthly prospect-search quota.

tools.name: geoa_radar_score_prospects
tools.description: GEO-score the prospects in a Radar search (search_id from geoa_radar_find_prospects): healthy company + weak AI visibility = highest sales priority. Scoring runs in the background — call again with the same search_id to fetch results. Requires sign-in to a geoa account.

tools.name: geoa_radar_enrich
tools.description: Enrich a company domain with verified registry data via Nordic Data (CVR/Brønnøysund/Bolagsverket etc.): registered name, company number, industry code, legal form, status. Counts against the plan's monthly lookup quota. Requires sign-in to a geoa account. Company-level data only — never persons.
